faqs.q: Is credentialing included with Hayat Health's RCM?
faqs.a: Yes, credentialing is included at no additional charge with all RCM engagements. This covers initial enrollment, revalidations, CAQH maintenance, and payer relations.

faqs.q: What is Hayat Health's collection guarantee?
faqs.a: Hayat Health guarantees 97% collection performance. If collections fall below 97%, their fee is reduced proportionally - for example, a 4.5% fee becomes 3.5% if collections drop to 96%.

faqs.q: How does Hayat Health's tiered pricing work?
faqs.a: Pricing is based on monthly collections: 5% on the first $100k, 4% on $100k-$300k, and 3% above $300k. A practice collecting $500k/month pays a blended rate of about 3.8%.

faqs.q: Can I get credentialing without full RCM?
faqs.a: Yes, Hayat Health offers standalone credentialing at $150 per provider per payer (one-time), or a $1,600/month retainer for up to 10 providers with unlimited support.

faqs.q: What RCM teams does Hayat Health have?
faqs.a: Six specialized teams: Benefit Verification, Certified Coding, Claim Submission, A/R Resolution, Denial Recovery, and Reporting & Quality Management. Each team's output feeds the next.

faqs.q: Does Hayat Health offer a hybrid billing model?
faqs.a: Yes, they offer both Full-Service RCM (they own the complete revenue cycle) and a Hybrid/Support Model where they reinforce your existing billing team by handling backlogs, denials, coding review, or credentialing.

faqs.q: What add-on services does Hayat Health offer?
faqs.a: Optional add-ons include: 24/7 AI-powered call center, online presence management (SEO, social media, reviews), staffing services (hiring, HR, payroll), specialized office support, and access to deeply discounted EHR pricing through their partner network.

company_info.notes: Chicago-area RCM and office management company. Offers integrated billing, credentialing, IT, marketing, and accounting services for medical practices.
